/api/routine-templates.prompt:
Review the commits on the routine's branch since the last run (the host gives the start and head SHAs; read them with git log and git show). Look for bugs, missing error handling, unsafe input handling, dead code and missing tests.

Fix only the issues that are clear and small: one obvious change each, with a test when the repo has tests for that code. Do not refactor, rename or restyle. List every other finding in the PR description under "Not fixed", with file:line and one line on why it matters.

When you find nothing worth a change, make no change and say so.
/api/routine-templates.about: Reads the new commits for bugs, missing error handling, unsafe input, dead code and missing tests, and fixes only the small, clear issues.
/api/routine-templates.name: Code review

/api/routine-templates.prompt:
Review the code that changed on the routine's branch since the last run (the host gives the start and head SHAs) for security defects: untrusted input that reaches a shell, a query, a file path or HTML; missing access checks; secrets in code or logs; weak crypto; unsafe dependencies.

Report only. Change no code and open no PR: a fix in public would disclose the issue before a release. For each finding give the file:line, how a caller reaches it, the impact, and the fix you suggest. Say how sure you are.

When you find nothing, say so in one line.
/api/routine-templates.about: Looks for untrusted input, missing access checks, secrets and weak crypto in the changed code. It changes no code, because a public fix would disclose the issue before a release.
/api/routine-templates.name: Security review
